name: code-comments
description: Help humans understand and review LLM-written code through accurate, useful source comments.

interface.shortDescription: Make LLM-written code clear for human reviewers.
interface.longDescription: Add, improve, or audit comments that give human reviewers a mental model of generated code: its approach, contracts, assumptions, domain concepts, and important constraints, grounded in implementation and empirical research.
defaultPrompt: Add comments so I can understand and review this LLM-written code.
Audit this module for inaccurate, redundant, or missing comments.
Add useful API documentation and explain non-obvious constraints.
